SELECT sm.match_id, sm.title, sm.sport_id, sm.facility_id, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.max_participants, sm.fee_per_person, sm.status FROM social_match sm JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sm.match_id = #{matchId} FOR UPDATE OF sm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_application (match_id, applicant_user_id, club_id, application_type, status, receipt_no, created_at, group_application_id) VALUES (#{matchId}, #{applicantUserId}, #{clubId}, #{applicationType}, #{status}, #{receiptNo}, #{createdAt}, #{groupApplicationId})
mapper.sql: application_id, match_id, applicant_user_id, club_id, application_type, status, receipt_no, created_at, confirmed_at, group_application_id, payment_id, refunded_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_application ma JOIN social_match sm ON sm.match_id = ma.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} WHERE ma.application_id = #{applicationId}

UPDATE match_participant SET participation_status = #{cancelledStatus}, cancelled_at = #{now} WHERE application_id IN (SELECT application_id FROM match_application WHERE group_application_id = #{groupApplicationId}) AND participation_status IN

mapper.select: SELECT ma.application_id, ma.applicant_user_id AS user_id, u.nickname, ma.status FROM match_application ma JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = ma.applicant_user_id WHERE ma.group_application_id = #{groupApplicationId} ORDER BY (ma.application_id = #{groupApplicationId}) DESC, ma.created_at, ma.application_id

SELECT ma.application_id, ma.applicant_user_id AS user_id, u.nickname, ma.status FROM match_application ma JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = ma.applicant_user_id WHERE ma.group_application_id = #{groupApplicationId} ORDER BY (ma.application_id = #{groupApplicationId}) DESC, ma.created_at, ma.application_id FOR UPDATE OF ma

SELECT ma.application_id, ma.match_id, ma.applicant_user_id, ma.application_type, ma.status, ma.created_at, sm.title, s.name AS sport_name, f.name AS facility_name, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.status AS match_status, mine.match_side, ma.group_application_id, leader.applicant_user_id AS group_leader_user_id, lu.nickname AS group_leader_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_application g WHERE g.group_application_id = ma.group_application_id AND g.status = ma.status) AS group_size, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_participant p WHERE p.application_id = ma.application_id AND p.participation_status IN
#{st} ) AS participant_count, ma.payment_id, pay.payer_user_id, pay.unit_amount, pay.total_amount, pay.refunded_amount FROM match_application ma JOIN social_match sm ON sm.match_id = ma.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id JOIN sport s ON s.sport_id = sm.sport_id LEFT JOIN match_participant mine ON mine.application_id = ma.application_id AND mine.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN match_application leader ON leader.application_id = ma.group_application_id LEFT JOIN app_user lu ON lu.user_id = leader.applicant_user_id LEFT JOIN payment pay ON pay.payment_id = ma.payment_id WHERE ma.applicant_user_id = #{userId} OR mine.participant_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sm.start_at, ma.application_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_participant (application_id, match_id, user_id, participation_status, entry_mmr, joined_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{matchId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{entryMmr}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT fm.user_id FROM social_match sm JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE sm.match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY fm.user_id
mapper.sql: c.club_id, c.club_name, c.sport_id, (SELECT lu.nickname FROM club_member lm JOIN app_user lu ON lu.user_id = lm.user_id WHERE lm.club_id = c.club_id AND lm.left_at IS NULL AND lm.role = '동호회장' ORDER BY lm.joined_at LIMIT 1) AS leader_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member am WHERE am.club_id = c.club_id AND am.left_at IS NULL) AS member_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM club c JOIN club_member me ON me.club_id = c.club_id AND me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.sport_id = #{sportId} ORDER BY c.club_name, c.club_id
SELECT FROM club c JOIN club_member me ON me.club_id = c.club_id AND me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.club_id = #{clubId}
